Eli (AE): Heads-up — Large Enterprise wants a 2-week POC starting next Monday. Primary asks: SAML SSO via Okta, SCIM provisioning, domain verification for two domains, RBAC controls (prevent devs from creating apps), and a short security questionnaire. Any immediate blockers?
Maria (SE): Sounds doable. Quick clarifying Qs: do they prefer IdP metadata URL or uploading SP metadata? For SCIM, do they need incremental (delta) sync + PATCH? Also which groups->roles mapping semantics do they expect?
Eli (AE): They prefer metadata URL. Okta initially, may add Azure AD later. SCIM should support incremental syncs; they may want PATCH for bulk group updates. They also asked if we can let them have separate domain owners and a way to restrict who can create apps.
Samir (SecEng): Security notes: we need to confirm if they require encrypted SAML assertions and signed logout. Also need NameID format and expected attribute mappings. For production domain ownership requires DNS TXT proof; for a POC we can accept admin email verification. We also need their completed security questionnaire before granting Dedicated trial.
Jessica (CS): Pricing question from procurement: are POC credits enough for SCIM+SSO setup and basic load testing? Sales typically offers credits + a short Dedicated trial if needed. I'll flag this if they request reserved capacity.
Maria (SE): Implementation details we'll share:
- SAML: support SP- and IdP-initiated flows, configurable NameID (email/persistent), required attributes (email, givenName, familyName, groups).
- SCIM: full CRUD + PATCH, supports incremental delta syncs (30s window), default rate limit 100 req/min (can relax for short POC). Example PATCH payload they can send:
```json
{"schemas":["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],"Operations":[{"op":"Replace","path":"members","value":[{"value":"alice@acme.com"}]}]}
```
- RBAC: Console has mapping UI (group -> app role). Nested groups are flattened for enforcement but we preserve the source path as metadata.
Maria (SE): If customer has >10k users we'll recommend batching and paging configs; if group churn >500/min open capacity ticket.
Eli (AE): Domain control: they want two domains on one org. For POC we'll accept email-based verification for the secondary domain; production requires DNS TXT + optional MX check for strict enforcement.
Samir (SecEng): Also need to confirm certificate rotation policy — we support automatic rollover for SP certs but want their rotation cadence. We'll include a short one-pager with sections: SAML metadata URL, encryption requirement (yes/no), NameID, attributes, logout/signed-logout, cert rotation window.
Jessica (CS): POC success criteria ask: can we commit to an auth flow 95th latency < 300ms, SCIM up to 5k provisioning ops/day, role sync within 60s? If Dedicated trial requested, we need to define throughput targets to size GPUs.
Eli (AE): I'll ask Acme to fill the one-pager + send IdP metadata URL and the security questionnaire. I'll also confirm their expected user counts and peak provisioning rates.
Maria (SE): I'll draft the connector checklist, RBAC CSV template, and sample SCIM payloads and upload to the shared drive.
Samir (SecEng): I'll review their questionnaire when it's back; highlight audit log retention, SAML assertion encryption, and MFA expectations for admin accounts as potential blockers.
deploy-bot: Provisioning task created: workspace acme-poc, task id poc-2026-0316-42.
Eli (AE): Thanks — I'll loop them in and post their metadata + completed questionnaire in this thread once received. :thumbsup:
